n296222c6abe.s:
Assertion (A): An EOU does not involve a developer-led enclave with its own infrastructure.
Reason (R): An EOU is a single unit that may be located anywhere under the Foreign Trade Policy scheme.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n296222c6abe.x: An EOU is a single unit located anywhere under the FTP scheme, which is why it has no developer-led enclave; the developer-plus-units structure belongs to an SEZ under the SEZ Act, 2005.

n0b4a019cc66.s: Which of the following pairs regarding Andhra Pradesh's export rank in FY 2024-25 is correctly matched?
o: Mica, coal and other ores – Third
n0b4a019cc66.x: In FY 2024-25 AP ranked first in marine products with a 43% share; it was first in ores, second in coffee and third in spices.

n500db77b6c0.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: only two dates in the facts)
n500db77b6c0.s: In which year was the SEZ policy announced in India under the EXIM Policy?
n500db77b6c0.x: The SEZ policy was announced in 2000 under the EXIM Policy/Foreign Trade Policy; the SEZ Act followed in 2005.

n716ae0ced8e.s: Which is the nodal agency for industrial parks and SEZs in Andhra Pradesh?
n716ae0ced8e.x: APIIC is the nodal agency for industrial parks and SEZs in AP and has developed 10 SEZs.

n7c6599c36be.s: The Districts as Export Hubs (DEH) initiative was launched under the Foreign Trade Policy in:
n7c6599c36be.x: DEH was launched in 2019 under the FTP, with DGFT as nodal agency.

nd583574ca26.s: The shrimp exported mainly from Andhra Pradesh is:
nd583574ca26.x: AP's shrimp exports are mainly white-leg shrimp, grown chiefly in West Godavari, Krishna and Nellore.

ndc5ccc73a40.s: NITI Aayog prepared the first Export Preparedness Index (2020) with:
ndc5ccc73a40.x: The first EPI, released in 2020, was prepared by NITI Aayog with the Institute for Competitiveness.

nd5e4a7cd98d.s: Under the SEZ framework, an SEZ may be set up by:
o: Only a joint venture of the Centre and a State
The Centre, a State or any person, jointly or severally
nd5e4a7cd98d.x: An SEZ may be established by the Centre, a State or any person, jointly or severally; it is not restricted to government joint ventures.

n8f306dac856.s: AP's Industrial Development Policy 4.0 (2024-29) targets exports of:
n8f306dac856.x: The policy targets US$ 40 billion exports, along with Rs 30 lakh crore investment and 175+ industrial parks.

nfc76470bd52.s: Under CBIC guidelines, a new dry port is generally not allowed within ____ of a seaport.
nfc76470bd52.x: New dry ports are generally not allowed within 200 km of a seaport (or within 100 km of an ICD).

n507ec01d041.s: The AP Retail Trade Policy 2015–20 targeted how many additional retail jobs by 2020?
n507ec01d041.x: The policy targeted 20,000 additional jobs in the retail sector by 2020.

n1bff549d045.s: Which of the following is an objective of the Andhra Pradesh Export Promotion Policy (APEX) 2022–27?
o: Integrated export ecosystems from districts to ports
n1bff549d045.x: APEX 2022–27 promotes global market access, logistics, competitiveness and integrated district-to-port export ecosystems.

n571758681ba.s: In FY 2024-25, Andhra Pradesh was the ____ largest exporting State of India.
n571758681ba.x: AP was the sixth largest exporting State in FY 2024-25, shipping 824 commodities to 194 countries.

nc297c5141e9.s: India's first coastal industrial corridor is:
nc297c5141e9.x: The Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC) is India's first coastal industrial corridor and part of the East Coast Economic Corridor.

ne8f93b7e8b6.shape: one-liner (NOT form kept: only one non-export is confirmed)
ne8f93b7e8b6.s: Which one of the following is NOT a major export product of Andhra Pradesh?
ne8f93b7e8b6.x: Crude oil is not an AP export in the stated data; marine products, pharmaceuticals, food products, textiles and engineering goods are.

ndec00f0cb38.s: As of July 2023, how many notified SEZs did Andhra Pradesh have?
ndec00f0cb38.x: AP had 32 notified SEZs as of July 2023; 19 refers to operational SEZs around January 2019.

ndb8da612411.s: Andhra Pradesh's exports of petroleum products are associated with the refinery at:
ndb8da612411.x: Petroleum product exports come from the Visakhapatnam refinery, not Kurnool.

n290e1a462a6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about centrally protected monuments in India?
o: The AMASR Act was enacted in 1972
The Antiquities and Art Treasures Act was enacted in 1972
n290e1a462a6.x: The AMASR Act dates from 1958; 1972 is the year of the Antiquities and Art Treasures Act.

ndbf28eced86.s:
Assertion (A): Andhra Pradesh has no UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Reason (R): India has 45 UNESCO World Heritage Sites as of July 2026.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ndbf28eced86.x: Both are true: AP has no WHS and India has 45 sites (July 2026), but India's total does not explain AP having none.

nee0e8dc22bd.s: Google's proposed AI data centre at Visakhapatnam and Anakapalli involves an investment of:
nee0e8dc22bd.x: The AI hub, Google's largest outside the US, has a proposed investment of US$15 billion (about Rs 87,520 crore).

n3879989db9a.s: Which tourism scheme is associated with the exclusive development of pilgrimage sites?
n3879989db9a.x: Exclusive pilgrimage-site development is under PRASHAD; Swadesh Darshan (2014–15) is a theme-based circuit scheme and SD 2.0 focuses on sustainable destinations.

n0720cd0d905.s: The Annavaram temple stands on which hill?
n0720cd0d905.x: Annavaram is on Ratnagiri hill near the Pampa; Seshachalam is Tirumala, Indrakeeladri is Kanaka Durga and Nallamala is Srisailam.

nc73c6b30eaa.s: The Statue of Unity was sculpted by:
nc73c6b30eaa.x: The 182 m Statue of Unity at Kevadia, dedicated to Sardar Patel, was sculpted by Ram V. Sutar.

nf95420d8f13.s: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) was launched on:
nf95420d8f13.x: PMJDY was launched on 28 August 2014 and has over 54 crore accounts.

n4aa89054976.s: The Travel and Tourism Competitiveness Index has been renamed as the:
n4aa89054976.x: The WEF's Travel and Tourism Competitiveness Index is now the Travel and Tourism Development Index.

nd3dea4f89dd.s: Nainital and Mussoorie hill stations are in:
nd3dea4f89dd.x: Nainital and Mussoorie are in Uttarakhand; Shimla and Manali are in Himachal Pradesh and Darjeeling in West Bengal.

n6cc0fb59225.s: After eleven entry ports were added in August 2026, India's e-Visa checkpoints rose from 77 to:
n6cc0fb59225.x: Adding eleven ports in August 2026 raised e-Visa checkpoints from 77 to 88.

n750fa3ef79d.s: The Golden Chariot luxury train is associated with:
n750fa3ef79d.x: Golden Chariot is Karnataka's luxury train; Palace on Wheels is Rajasthan and Deccan Odyssey is Maharashtra.

nace61851379.s: In FY24, travel and tourism accounted for what share of India's GDP?
nace61851379.x: Travel and tourism was 5.22 per cent of GDP in FY24; 13.3 per cent is its share of the workforce.

n5972882f29f.s: How many beach circuits are identified along Andhra Pradesh's 1,053 km coastline?
n5972882f29f.x: Five beach circuits are associated with AP's 1,053 km coastline.

na02707d331a.s: Borra Caves were found in 1807 by:
na02707d331a.x: William King George of the GSI found Borra Caves in 1807; Robert Bruce Foote recorded Belum Caves in 1884.

ne0871fe2e78.s: Akal Wood Fossil Park is located in:
ne0871fe2e78.x: Akal Wood Fossil Park is in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan; Siwalik Fossil Park is in Himachal Pradesh.

n6fa2a63d9b8.s: Kothapatnam beach is near which town?
n6fa2a63d9b8.x: Kothapatnam beach is near Ongole (Prakasam district); Manginapudi is near Machilipatnam.

n404188691e4.s: Belum Caves, declared a geo-heritage site by the GSI in 2025, are in which district?
n404188691e4.x: The GSI declared Belum Caves in Nandyal district, AP, a geo-heritage site in 2025.

ne7d5c76fbb8.s: Ahobilam, known for its nine Narasimha shrines, is in which district?
ne7d5c76fbb8.x: Ahobilam, with nine Narasimha shrines, is in Nandyal district.

n594931367f7.s: The AP Tourism Policy 2024–29 plans more than how many thematic tourism circuits?
n594931367f7.x: The policy plans more than 25 thematic circuits, including Buddhist, temple, beach and river-cruise circuits.

n211b0c7978c.s: Which temple of Andhra Pradesh has both a Jyotirlinga and a Shakti Peetha?
n211b0c7978c.x: Srisailam has the Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga and the Bhramaramba Shakti Peetha.

nbb011549e38.s: Kondapalli toys of NTR district are made from which soft wood?
nbb011549e38.x: Kondapalli toys use soft Tella Poniki wood; Etikoppaka toys of Anakapalli use lacquer and natural dyes.

nap-geography-29-6.s: Which of the following power plants of Andhra Pradesh is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Simhadri STPS – NTPC plant near Visakhapatnam
Dr. Narla Tata Rao TPS – Ibrahimpatnam, near Vijayawada
Sri Damodaram Sanjeevaiah TPS – Kalamalla, YSR Kadapa
nap-geography-29-6.x: Sri Damodaram Sanjeevaiah TPS is at Krishnapatnam, Nellore; Kalamalla is the Rayalaseema TPS.

na7d2194c076.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about energy storage in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The Pinnapuram pumped storage project in Kurnool is 1,680 MW
Pinnapuram is the world's first integrated renewable-energy storage project
The Upper Sileru pumped storage project is 1,350 MW
AP plans 3,931 MW of pumped storage by 2035-36
na7d2194c076.x: The CEA plan is 7,370 MW of pumped storage and 3,931 MW of battery storage; the figure stated is battery, not pumped, storage.

nap-geography-16-27.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the ReNew Power Integrated Project in Andhra Pradesh?
nap-geography-16-27.x: The project's total capacity is 2.8 GW; 1.8 GWp is only its solar component.

nap-geography-29-4.s:
Assertion (A): Lower Sileru Power House is at Mothugudem.
Reason (R): Srisailam Right Bank Power House is at Ibrahimpatnam, near Vijayawada.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nap-geography-29-4.x: Lower Sileru is at Mothugudem, but Srisailam Right Bank is at Sunnipenta (erstwhile Kurnool); Ibrahimpatnam has the Narla Tata Rao TPS.

n1ffb0890f22.s:
Assertion (A): Stage III of India's nuclear programme is based on enriched uranium in light-water reactors.
Reason (R): Stage I uses PHWRs fuelled by natural uranium with heavy water as moderator.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n1ffb0890f22.x: Stage III is thorium-based (AHWR), so A is false; R correctly describes Stage I PHWRs.

n980b5c61e55.s: Which is India's first public-sector oil refinery?
n980b5c61e55.x: Guwahati is India's first public-sector refinery.

n8989991d671.s: Which is the largest component of India's renewable energy capacity?
n8989991d671.x: Solar (about 164.59 GW) is the largest RE component; wind is about 58.14 GW.

nindian-geography-29-2.s: The Vadinar refinery is operated by:
nindian-geography-29-2.x: Vadinar belongs to Nayara Energy; Jamnagar belongs to Reliance.

nindian-geography-51-2.s: Kakrapar Atomic Power Station is located in:
nindian-geography-51-2.x: Kakrapar is in Gujarat; Narora is in Uttar Pradesh.

nenvironment-35-6.x: Uranium is a non-renewable nuclear fuel; natural gas is a non-renewable fossil fuel.

nindian-geography-51-1.s: Kaiga Nuclear Power Plant is located in:
nindian-geography-51-1.x: Kaiga is in Karnataka; Tarapur is in Maharashtra, Rawatbhata in Rajasthan and Kudankulam in Tamil Nadu.

n72cbddd6e50.s: India's Strategic Petroleum Reserves are at Padur, Mangaluru and:
n72cbddd6e50.x: The SPRs are at Padur, Visakhapatnam and Mangaluru (about 5.33 MMT); Chandikhol is a Phase-II site.

n9c315874047.s: Coal meets about what share of India's primary energy needs?
n9c315874047.x: Coal meets about 55% of India's primary energy needs and produces over 70% of its electricity.

nindian-geography-51-6.s: Kudgi thermal power station is located in:
nindian-geography-51-6.x: Kudgi is in Karnataka; Ramagundam is in Telangana, Neyveli in Tamil Nadu and Uran in Maharashtra.

n0911cf729cd.s: Which is India's largest thermal power station?
n0911cf729cd.x: India's largest thermal station is Vindhyachal (Singrauli, MP), not Simhadri.

n9d4b9503a77.s: Singareni Collieries Company Limited is jointly owned by Telangana and the Union Government in the ratio:
n9d4b9503a77.x: SCCL is owned 51:49 by Telangana and the Centre and mines Godavari Valley coal.

n06de4285f3f.s: The Barmer oil field is located in:
n06de4285f3f.x: Barmer is in Rajasthan; Digboi is in Assam and Mumbai High is offshore in the Arabian Sea.

nc4cfad39ecc.s: Commercial oil production began at Digboi in:
nc4cfad39ecc.x: Commercial production began at Digboi in 1889; the first well was drilled in 1866-67 and the refinery came in 1901.

nc2e5d04b6a3.s: Which State has the highest hydropower potential in India?
nc2e5d04b6a3.x: Arunachal Pradesh has the highest hydel potential in India.

nc19a4f91521.s: Which of the following is a non-renewable source of energy?
nc19a4f91521.x: Nuclear energy is non-renewable because it uses finite fuels such as uranium and thorium.

nindian-geography-4-4.s: India's first horticulture university was set up at:
nindian-geography-4-4.x: The first horticulture university was at Solan; Pantnagar had the first agricultural university and Pratappur the first sugar mill.

n6cd00a5d65f.s: After bifurcation, Andhra Pradesh lost its coal mines. A direct result is:
n6cd00a5d65f.x: Having lost its coal mines, AP relies on coal transported from distant sources, raising transport costs.

necc6f892c70.s: The Makum coalfield is located in:
necc6f892c70.x: Makum is in Assam; Jharia is in Jharkhand, Talcher in Odisha and Singareni in Telangana.

nchemistry-9-13.s: Water gas is a mixture of:
nchemistry-9-13.x: Water gas is CO + H₂; producer gas is CO + H₂ + N₂.

nindian-geography-20-4.s: The Ramganga project is located in which district of Uttarakhand?
nindian-geography-20-4.x: Ramganga is in Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand.

nf3995aeaed0.s: Nuclear power plants generally operate at a capacity factor of:
nf3995aeaed0.x: Nuclear plants generally run at 85–90%, against 20–25% for solar and 25–35% for wind.

n5567e122e6b.s: Coal-fired power plants generally operate at a plant load factor of about:
n5567e122e6b.x: Coal plants generally operate at about 60–85% PLF and can run round the clock.

n3f55057e6f1.s: The coal of the Damodar valley belongs to which age?
n3f55057e6f1.x: Damodar valley coal is Gondwana coal, 250-300 million years old; Tertiary coal (15-60 million years) occurs in the North-East.

nfe5f05c8d1a.s: The headquarters of the International Solar Alliance is at:
nfe5f05c8d1a.x: ISA, launched by India and France at COP21 (2015), is headquartered at Gurugram, India.

nf007e872108.x: India's net-zero year is 2070; 2050 is the target of many developed countries.

n3917245f3c6.s: The largest lignite deposits in India are in:
n3917245f3c6.x: The largest lignite deposits are in Tamil Nadu (Neyveli), followed by Rajasthan and Gujarat; Jharkhand leads in coal.

nchemistry-9-5.s: Biogas contains methane in the range of:
nchemistry-9-5.x: Biogas is 50–75% methane and 25–50% CO₂; natural gas is 70–90% methane.

nap-geography-16-6.s: Polavaram Hydro Power Project's 12 Kaplan turbines of 80 MW each give a total capacity of:
nap-geography-16-6.x: 12 turbines of 80 MW each give Polavaram 960 MW.

nchemistry-9-11.s: Kerosene consists of hydrocarbons in the range:
nchemistry-9-11.x: Kerosene is C₁₀–C₁₆; petrol is C₅–C₁₀ and diesel C₁₅–C₁₈.

nindian-geography-29-20.x: Haldia was commissioned in 1975; 1901 is Digboi.

nindian-geography-20-5.s: The Baira Siul project is located in which district of Himachal Pradesh?
nindian-geography-20-5.x: Baira Siul is in Chamba, Himachal Pradesh.

nindian-geography-29-5.s: Digboi Refinery, linked with India's early oil industry, was commissioned in:
nindian-geography-29-5.x: Digboi was commissioned in 1901; 1975 is Haldia.

n322ee18c633.s: Under PM Surya Ghar, a 1–3 kW rooftop solar system can provide up to how many free units per month?
n322ee18c633.x: A 1–3 kW system under PM Surya Ghar can provide up to 300 free units per month.

n9fb9a3fe343.s: Under the Revised SHAKTI policy (May 2025), coal is allocated through how many windows?
n9fb9a3fe343.x: The Revised SHAKTI policy of May 2025 allocates coal through two windows.

n6f34eea71bc.s: Under Budget 2026–27, what customs duty does monazite attract?
n6f34eea71bc.x: Budget 2026–27 set nil duty on monazite and no basic customs duty on capital goods for processing critical minerals.

n496471da374.s: Hydrogen produced from gas with carbon capture and storage is called:
n496471da374.x: Blue hydrogen comes from gas with CCS; green hydrogen comes from renewable-powered electrolysis.

na32c88f7452.s: Most of India's hydroelectric potential lies in the basins of the:
o: Himalayan rivers – Brahmaputra, Indus and Ganga
na32c88f7452.x: The Himalayan basins hold most of the potential because of perennial snow-fed flow and steep gradients; Peninsular rivers are seasonal.

na1c2652b4af.s: Off-stream closed-loop pumped storage projects no longer require concurrence from:
na1c2652b4af.x: Off-stream closed-loop pumped storage projects no longer need Central Electricity Authority concurrence.

n2aaac69bc2c.s: The National Green Hydrogen Mission (outlay ₹19,744 crore) targets production of:
n2aaac69bc2c.x: The mission has an outlay of ₹19,744 crore and targets 5 million metric tonnes of green hydrogen a year.

nad13b755aef.s: The Digboi refinery in Assam is operated by:
nad13b755aef.x: Digboi is operated by IOCL; Numaligarh is NRL, Jamnagar Reliance and Visakhapatnam HPCL.

nworld-geography-17-4.s: Which of the following railways is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Canadian Pacific Railway – First transcontinental railway of Canada
Trans-Andean Railway – Highest railway in the world
Qinghai–Tibet Railway – Highest railway in the world
nworld-geography-17-4.x: The Trans-Andean Railway crosses the Andes between Chile and Argentina; the highest railway is the Qinghai–Tibet line.

n64adc844421.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's logistics sector?
o: The official logistics cost is 7.97% of GDP (2023-24)
India ranked 25th in the World Bank LPI 2023
NLP 2022 aims for a top-25 LPI rank by 2030
NLP 2022 targets a single-digit logistics cost
n64adc844421.x: India ranked 38th in LPI 2023; a top-25 rank is only the NLP target for 2030.

ne2fdd6f3dc5.s:
Assertion (A): The LEADS index uses only objective data.
Reason (R): The LEADS index is modelled on the World Bank's Logistics Performance Index.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ne2fdd6f3dc5.x: LEADS (DPIIT, 2018) is modelled on the World Bank LPI but combines perception and objective data, so A is false.

ne4f8548e116.s: Under PMGSY (launched 2000), habitations in plain areas are eligible if their population is:
ne4f8548e116.x: In plain areas habitations of 500+ are eligible; the LWE threshold is 100+ and 250+ applies to NE, hill and tribal areas.

n75a80c21d4d.s: The PM GatiShakti National Master Plan was launched on:
n75a80c21d4d.x: PM GatiShakti, a GIS-based integrated planning platform, was launched on 13 October 2021.

n2427c186b94.s: The headquarters of the South Coast Railway zone is at:
n2427c186b94.x: South Coast Railway, the 18th zone created under the AP Reorganisation Act 2014, is headquartered at Visakhapatnam.

n56cd5ae6de2.s: The East-West Corridor meets the North-South Corridor at:
n56cd5ae6de2.x: The East-West Corridor (Silchar–Porbandar) meets the North-South Corridor at Jhansi.

nd68d27a43ed.s: Andhra Pradesh ranks first in India in the export of:
nd68d27a43ed.x: AP, the sixth largest exporting State, ranks first in tobacco and marine exports.

n5250fa975c4.s: The Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor runs from Ludhiana to:
n5250fa975c4.x: The Eastern DFC links Ludhiana and Sonnagar; the Western DFC links Dadri and JNPT.

ned496c8f07d.s: Budget 2026-27 proposes how many new National Waterways over five years?
ned496c8f07d.x: Budget 2026-27 proposes 20 new National Waterways in five years, starting with NW-5 in Odisha.

nworld-geography-17-5.s: The Trans-Siberian Railway was built mainly between:
nworld-geography-17-5.x: The Trans-Siberian Railway was built mainly in 1891–1916; the Baikal–Amur Mainline runs parallel to it.

nworld-geography-17-6.s: The Trans-Siberian Railway, which crosses 8 time zones, is how long?
nworld-geography-17-6.x: The Trans-Siberian Railway is 9,289 km long and crosses 8 time zones.

ne89b269343b.x: The Orient Express linked Paris and Istanbul.

n85280efaf1d.s: The Bharatmala programme (2017) envisages about how many km of National Highway corridors?
n85280efaf1d.x: Bharatmala, launched in 2017, covers 34,800 km of National Highway corridors.

nef52017d1bb.s: The 1,506-km Western Dedicated Freight Corridor is funded by:
nef52017d1bb.x: The Western DFC is JICA-funded; the 1,337-km Eastern DFC is World Bank-funded.

nb9440ef739b.s: Compared with road freight, rail freight emits about how much less CO2?
nb9440ef739b.x: Rail emits about 90% less CO2 than road and costs about half as much.

nc34c5541eb6.s: Which of the following fields is INCORRECTLY matched with the disciplines it combines?
o: Cyber-physical systems – Computing and physical systems through sensors
nc34c5541eb6.x: Data science combines statistics and computing; biology and engineering make up biotechnology.

n04da32e46fc.s: The Statement on Scientific Temper was issued in:
n04da32e46fc.x: The Statement on Scientific Temper dates to 1981; 1962 is the Kerala Sastra Sahitya Parishad and 2013 the Maharashtra Anti-Superstition Act.

n5a3120ee8de.s: Curiosity-driven inquiry is a characteristic of:
n5a3120ee8de.x: Basic research is curiosity-driven; applied research addresses a set problem and technology produces products and processes.

n613bb2f102e.s: Which Article asks citizens to develop the scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform?
n613bb2f102e.x: Article 51A(h), added by the 42nd Amendment (1976), carries this duty; Nehru popularised the phrase 'scientific temper'.

n6ea9df1ce0a.s: India's rank in the Global Innovation Index 2025 was:
n6ea9df1ce0a.x: India ranked 38th in the GII 2025; it was 49th in the Network Readiness Index 2024.

n54a9294167f.s: Turning an invention into value in the market or society is called:
n54a9294167f.x: Innovation turns an invention (the first creation of a product or process) into market or social value.

n99830d7abee.x: FASTag is a passive RFID tag powered by the toll reader's field; a metro smart card is passive NFC.

ncaac9e9d39f.s: A claim that asserts scientific status without being testable is:
ncaac9e9d39f.x: Pseudoscience claims scientific status while lacking testability; science is systematic, self-correcting and reproducible.

nc97337b2e99.s: In the scientific method, which stage comes immediately after framing the question?
nc97337b2e99.x: The sequence is observation, question, hypothesis, experiment, analysis and conclusion.

na0ecdd46c44.s: Which of the following imaging techniques is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: CT scan – Computer reconstruction of many X-ray images
Ultrasound – High-frequency sound waves and echoes
na0ecdd46c44.x: MRI uses a strong magnetic field and radio waves acting on hydrogen nuclei, not ionising radiation.

nbiology-25-4.s: Which of the following is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Umetaro Suzuki – Associated vitamin C with citrus curing scurvy
Frederick Gowland Hopkins – Accessory food factors
James Lind – Citrus fruits curing scurvy
nbiology-25-4.x: Suzuki extracted a water-soluble micronutrient mixture from rice bran; James Lind linked citrus with curing scurvy.

nchemistry-14-29.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about osmosis?
o: In reverse osmosis, pressure is applied on the dilute side
Solvent moves from low to high solute concentration
Plant roots absorb water by osmosis
nchemistry-14-29.x: In reverse osmosis external pressure is applied on the concentrated side.

nb1faa9d1f4e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about household appliances?
o: An LED emits light by electroluminescence at a p-n junction
A pressure cooker cooks faster because higher pressure raises the boiling point
An RO purifier applies pressure in the direction of osmosis
In a pressure cooker water boils at about 120 C
nb1faa9d1f4e.x: An RO purifier applies pressure against osmosis to push water through the semi-permeable membrane.

nchemistry-15-9.s: Which food preservative is INCORRECTLY matched with its use?
o: Sodium benzoate – Soft drinks and fruit juice
Sodium propionate – Stored grains, cheese and milk
Sulphur dioxide – Stored grains and milk
nchemistry-15-9.x: Sulphur dioxide preserves dried fruits and is used in winemaking; propionates preserve grains and cheese.

nbiology-6-8.s: Which of the following is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Wheat germ oil – Source of vitamin E
ATP → ADP – Biotransformation providing maximum energy
Carbohydrate + fat + protein – Maximum energy-yielding diet group
nbiology-6-8.x: Rice is noted for the highest percentage of carbohydrate; vitamin E comes from wheat germ oil.

nfd1d16bf0e5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about geospatial technology in public health?
o: Disease mapping is used to identify hotspots
Facility location may consider population distribution and travel time
Aarogya Setu used only Wi-Fi signals for contact tracing
Geospatial tools help select sites for PHCs and hospitals
nfd1d16bf0e5.x: Aarogya Setu used Bluetooth and GPS for COVID-19 contact tracing.

nbiology-35-4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the excretory system?
o: Urea is formed in the kidney
The kidney filters blood and forms urine
The kidney helps regulate long-term blood pressure
Urine flows kidney → ureter → bladder → urethra
nbiology-35-4.x: Urea is formed in the liver; the kidney only filters it out.

nphysics-19-10.s: Which use of ultrasound is INCORRECTLY matched?
nphysics-19-10.x: In industrial testing ultrasound detects cracks or flaws in metals; underwater detection is SONAR.

ne06deb97e7e.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: items carry no dates)
ne06deb97e7e.s: The food-safety reforms reported for July 2026 proposed ending dual certification under:
ne06deb97e7e.x: The July 2026 reforms included ending dual BIS/AGMARK certification, alongside Food Safety on Wheels, blockchain tracing and One Nation, One Regulator.

n810c5152ff6.s: Which sensor detects sudden deceleration to trigger a car's airbags?
n810c5152ff6.x: An accelerometer senses sudden deceleration to trigger airbags; it also enables step counting and screen rotation.

n3e662acc975.s: How many food irradiators has the Department of Atomic Energy installed in PPP mode?
n3e662acc975.x: DAE has installed 25 food irradiators in PPP mode; gamma rays extend potato and onion shelf life to eight months without cold storage.

nphysics-16-42.s: Which device converts sound vibrations into electrical signals by electromagnetic induction?
nphysics-16-42.x: A dynamic microphone turns sound vibrations into electrical signals by electromagnetic induction.

nbiology-6-6.s: Which oilseed has the maximum α-linolenic acid?
nbiology-6-6.x: Linseed oil has the maximum α-linolenic acid among oilseeds.

n690629977f0.s: Telemedicine in India needs an IT fibre backbone together with:
n690629977f0.x: Telemedicine needs a fibre backbone plus satellite communication; it is still nascent in the public sector.

n66bf1a9d899.s: Which of the following is a negative consequence of digital technology?
n66bf1a9d899.x: Cyber fraud (like screen-time effects) is a negative consequence; health tracking and digital payments are benefits.

nphysics-11-26.x: A hydraulic lift follows Pascal's principle; buoyancy is Archimedes' and wing lift Bernoulli's.

nde373d5ba56.s: Which type of dialysis uses the peritoneum as the filtering membrane?
nde373d5ba56.x: Peritoneal dialysis uses the peritoneum; haemodialysis uses a machine filter.

nchemistry-19-16.s: Hypo, used as a fixer in photography, is:
nchemistry-19-16.x: Hypo is sodium thiosulphate, Na₂S₂O₃, used as a photographic fixer.

nphysics-16-15.x: The elementary charge is 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C; one coulomb is the charge of 6.25 × 10¹⁸ electrons.

nphysics-20-31.x: Light waves serve vision and optical fibres; radio waves serve broadcasting and X-rays medical imaging.

nphysics-16-19.s: The SI unit of conductivity is:
nphysics-16-19.x: Conductivity (1/ρ) is measured in S/m; siemens is the unit of conductance.

nbiology-27-2.x: Casein is the major milk protein; gluten is in wheat, collagen in connective tissue and keratin in hair and nails.

nchemistry-8-11.x: Neoprene is made from chloroprene; natural rubber is from isoprene.

na6fa2696445.s: Besides tracking regional outbreaks, the epidemiology unit of AIIMS Mangalagiri maps indicators of:
na6fa2696445.x: The unit tracks regional outbreaks and maps non-communicable disease indicators.

nbiology-24-1.s: Vitamin B7 is also known as:
nbiology-24-1.x: B7 is biotin (vitamin H); B1 is thiamine, B2 riboflavin and B12 cobalamin.

nbiology-24-17.x: D3 is cholecalciferol; D2 is ergocalciferol.

naceacb37096.s: The unit of the power of a lens is:
naceacb37096.x: Lens power is 1/focal length in metres, measured in dioptres (D).

n25fcedf53a1.s: FSSAI marks fortified food with which logo?
n25fcedf53a1.x: FSSAI uses the '+F' logo for fortified foods, such as iodised salt.

nbiology-24-6.x: B6 is pyridoxine; B3 is niacin, B5 pantothenic acid and A retinol.

n20f2d1249ef.s: Which vehicle communication technology is Wi-Fi-based?
n20f2d1249ef.x: DSRC is Wi-Fi-based, while C-V2X uses 4G and 5G networks.

nbiology-21-1.x: Niacin deficiency causes pellagra; B1 causes beriberi, C scurvy and D rickets.

nchemistry-8-1.x: PVC is made from vinyl chloride; polythene is from ethene and Teflon from tetrafluoroethene.

n6a2e603fa21.s: A hydrogen fuel-cell vehicle emits only:
n6a2e603fa21.x: A fuel cell combines hydrogen and oxygen to produce electricity, emitting only water.

n23786f8a4a3.s: The indigenous Chitra heart valve was developed by:
n23786f8a4a3.x: The Chitra heart valve was developed by SCTIMST, Thiruvananthapuram.

nphysics-11-28.s: The red shift of receding galaxies is explained by:
nphysics-11-28.x: Red shift, blue shift and medical Doppler ultrasound all come from the Doppler principle.

nphysics-16-12.x: Wireless charging, like generators, transformers and induction cooktops, works by electromagnetic induction.

nchemistry-15-22.s: Which of the following is a disinfectant rather than an antiseptic?
nchemistry-15-22.x: Bleaching powder is a disinfectant; boric acid, iodoform and H₂O₂ are antiseptics.

nbiology-25-5.s: The main source of energy in the body is:
nbiology-25-5.x: Carbohydrates, not minerals, are the main energy source; amino acids build proteins.

nbiology-29-14.x: The testes, located in the scrotum, produce sperm and testosterone.

nphysics-16-11.s: A fuse works on which effect of electric current?
nphysics-16-11.x: A fuse uses the heating effect: its low-melting wire melts when current exceeds the rated value.

nphysics-16-16.s: The conventional direction of electric current is:
o: Along the direction of electron flow
nphysics-16-16.x: Conventional current flows positive to negative, opposite to electron flow.

nbiology-27-5.s: Kwashiorkor and marasmus are caused by deficiency of:
nbiology-27-5.x: Kwashiorkor and marasmus are protein-deficiency diseases.

nphysics-11-30.s: An ice-skater spins faster on pulling in the arms because of conservation of:
nphysics-11-30.x: Conservation of angular momentum explains the skater's spin and planetary orbits.

nbiology-6-5.s: The most abundant granulocytes in human blood are:
nbiology-6-5.x: Neutrophils, not basophils, are the most common granulocytes.

nphysics-11-21.s: The Equivalence Principle, also used in GPS time corrections, is the basis of:
nphysics-11-21.x: The equivalence principle underlies general relativity and is applied in GPS time corrections.

nphysics-20-30.s: Which of the following is used in security scanning?
nphysics-20-30.x: X-rays are used in security scanning; sound is used in sonar, radio in broadcasting and ultrasound in ranging.

nphysics-11-19.s: Which principle explains wavefront propagation, reflection and refraction of waves?
nphysics-11-19.x: Huygens' principle treats every point on a wavefront as a source, explaining propagation, reflection and refraction.

nchemistry-6-7.s: Which form of carbon is used as the reducing agent in iron extraction?
nchemistry-6-7.x: Coke, not carbon black, reduces iron ore; graphite is used in electrodes and activated charcoal in purification.

nbiology-24-23.s: Night blindness and xerophthalmia are caused by deficiency of:
nbiology-24-23.x: Vitamin A deficiency causes night blindness, xerophthalmia and skin keratinisation.

n528fc3bb784.s: Ultrasound is used to monitor foetal development because it:
n528fc3bb784.x: Ultrasound uses high-frequency sound waves and no ionising radiation, making it safe for foetal monitoring.

nbiology-30-10.s: Erythropoietin, which drives red blood cell production, is produced by the:
nbiology-30-10.x: The kidney produces erythropoietin; the placenta produces chorionic gonadotropin.

nbiology-35-9.s: The approximate pH of normal human urine is:
nbiology-35-9.x: Normal urine is slightly acidic, about pH 6.0.

nchemistry-15-3.s: Disinfectants are used only on non-living surfaces because they:
nchemistry-15-3.x: Disinfectants are toxic to tissue, so they are used on objects, while antiseptics are safe for living tissue.

nbiology-27-9.s: A nursing mother requires at least how much protein per day?
nbiology-27-9.x: A nursing mother needs at least about 65 g of protein a day; other women need about 45–46 g.

nphysics-18-17.s: A convex lens acts as a magnifying glass when the object is placed:
nphysics-18-17.x: Within F a convex lens forms a virtual, erect, magnified image, as in a magnifying glass.

nchemistry-19-23.s: Teflon, used as a non-stick coating, is also called:
nchemistry-19-23.x: Teflon is PTFE (polytetrafluoroethene), used as a non-stick coating.

nchemistry-6-32.s: Which of the following is used in electronics and nanotechnology?
nchemistry-6-32.x: Carbon nanotubes and fullerenes are used in nanotechnology; carbon black goes into tyres and monomers into plastics.

nbiology-24-4.s: Which of the following vitamins is water-soluble?
nbiology-24-4.x: B9 (like B1 and C) is water-soluble; vitamins A, D, E and K are fat-soluble.

n31225444ee3.s: In a vapour-compression refrigerator, the refrigerant absorbs heat while:
n31225444ee3.x: The refrigerant absorbs heat while evaporating inside and releases it at the condenser.

n43725ea4078.s: Which of the following was NOT an objective of the Science and Technology Policy, 2003?
o: Promotion of research, innovation and technology transfer
Placing India among the top five scientific powers by 2020
Optimal utilisation of existing physical and knowledge resources
n43725ea4078.x: The top-five-scientific-powers-by-2020 aim belongs to the STI Policy, 2013; the other three were 2003 objectives.

nc7b14060634.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's S&T policies?
o: SPR 1958, under Nehru, was the first comprehensive S&T policy
TPS 1983, under Indira Gandhi, stressed technological self-reliance
The S&T Policy, 2003 was issued under Manmohan Singh
The STI Policy, 2013 was issued under Manmohan Singh
nc7b14060634.x: The S&T Policy, 2003 came under A.B. Vajpayee; Manmohan Singh's was the STI Policy, 2013.

ne3acbee0ece.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Fund?
o: It gives concessional finance only to public-sector undertakings
It has an approved size of ₹1 lakh crore
It operates through a Special Purpose Fund in ANRF
ne3acbee0ece.x: The RDI Fund is meant to boost private R&D, not to finance only PSUs.

ne72c262fd59.s:
Assertion (A): One Nation, One Subscription was approved by the Cabinet with about Rs 60,000 crore for 2025-27.
Reason (R): The Draft STIP 2020 proposed One Nation, One Subscription for pan-India journal access.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ne72c262fd59.x: The ONOS outlay was about Rs 6,000 crore, not Rs 60,000 crore, so A is false; R is true.

n87fcc862af7.s:
Assertion (A): The STI Policy, 2013 aimed at GERD of 2% of GDP with private spending matching public spending.
Reason (R): The S&T Policy, 2003 aimed to raise GERD to 2% of GDP by the end of the Tenth Plan.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n87fcc862af7.x: Both are true GERD targets of two different policies; the 2003 target does not explain the 2013 one.

n948436a74cd.s: The STI Policy, 2013 aimed to raise India's share of global publications from 3.5% to over:
n948436a74cd.x: It aimed to raise the share from 3.5% to over 7% and to quadruple papers in the top 1% journals.

n6dd409c26ad.s: The STI Policy, 2013 proposed direct intervention in about how many high-impact sectors?
n6dd409c26ad.x: The 2013 policy envisaged STI intervention in about ten high-impact sectors.

nd85631340be.s: Who was India's first Principal Scientific Adviser?
nd85631340be.x: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam was the first PSA; the PSA office was created in 1999.

n1a03f45c274.s: The Draft STIP 2020 proposed hybrid funding from private capital and CSR for the:
n1a03f45c274.x: Draft STIP 2020 proposed a National Research Foundation with hybrid funding; the STI Development Bank was a corpus fund for long-term strategic areas.

nab300ea29da.s: The draft National Health Research Policy, 2026 proposes governance with how many tiers?
nab300ea29da.x: The draft, the first unified health-research framework by the Department of Health Research, proposes three-tier governance.

nde0de71d7d2.s: India's Technology Policy Statement was issued in:
nde0de71d7d2.x: The sequence is SPR 1958, TPS 1983, STP 2003 and STI Policy 2013.

n44354a59981.s: The Draft STIP 2020 proposed doubling FTE researchers, GERD and the private share of GERD every:
n44354a59981.x: Draft STIP 2020 proposed doubling FTE researchers, GERD and private GERD share every five years.

n9ca46ecc29d.s: Who is the President of the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF)?
n9ca46ecc29d.x: The Prime Minister is ANRF's President; the Ministers of S&T and Education are Vice-Presidents.

ndbf64be5e7c.s: The 2026 recommendations on research funding proposed a unified fellowship called:
ndbf64be5e7c.x: They proposed Vigyan Nidhi, NISPG and GERD of 2% of GDP within four to five years through the private sector.

n9242285238a.s: The Draft STIP 2020 proposed which approach to research governance?
n9242285238a.x: Draft STIP 2020 proposed decentralised, bottom-up governance with self-reliance, open science and equity.

n27facc7ac53.s: The parent department of CSIR is:
n27facc7ac53.x: DSIR, established in 1985, is CSIR's parent department; DST dates from 1971 and DBT from 1986.

nc7b3108e1c5.s: STIP 2020 is India's ____ national science and technology policy.
nc7b3108e1c5.x: SPR 1958 was the first national S&T policy and STIP 2020 the fifth.

nd1cfcb0e77b.s: The STI Policy, 2013 aimed to place India among the top ____ scientific powers by 2020.
nd1cfcb0e77b.x: The STI Policy, 2013 made innovation central and aimed for India to be among the top five scientific powers by 2020.

n4d859fed5a0.s:
Assertion (A): The Global Innovation Index is published by WIPO.
Reason (R): In the India Innovation Index 2021, Manipur led the Major States category.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n4d859fed5a0.x: GII is WIPO's; but Karnataka led the Major States in 2021, Manipur led the North-East and Hill States.

nc8643d4f49a.s: The slogan of the National IPR Policy, 2016 is:
o: Make in India; Innovate in India
nc8643d4f49a.x: The National IPR Policy, 2016 slogan is 'Creative India; Innovative India'.

n984f01b4ca4.s: In 2020–21, the private sector's share of India's GERD was about:
n984f01b4ca4.x: India's private share was about 36%, against about 70% in the USA and 76% in South Korea.

n8ff4f6157a1.s: The Patents Act, 1970 gives patent protection for:
n8ff4f6157a1.x: Patents under the 1970 Act last 20 years; the invention must be novel with commercial application.

n3640991ef82.s: Which body is the custodian of the RDI Scheme fund approved on 1 July 2025?
n3640991ef82.x: ANRF is the custodian of the Rs 1 lakh crore RDI fund.

nb72eb0f08fe.s: KIND-X is an innovation initiative between India and:
nb72eb0f08fe.x: KIND-X is an India-Korea initiative, not India-Japan.

n60efc173af4.s: India's Global Innovation Index rank in 2015 was:

nc132ed2bb68.s: Which of the following is a category in the India Innovation Index?
nc132ed2bb68.x: The categories are Major States, North-East and Hill States, and Union Territories and City States.

n98027a1683f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the leadership of CSIR?
o: The Prime Minister is its ex officio President
The Union S&T Minister is its ex officio President
The Director-General of CSIR is also Secretary, DSIR
The Director-General heads the Governing Body
n98027a1683f.x: The Prime Minister is CSIR's ex officio President; the Union S&T Minister is Vice-President.

necdc75b1026.s:
Assertion (A): BRIC, established in 2023, integrates 14 DBT institutions.
Reason (R): BRIC is chaired by the DBT Secretary.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
necdc75b1026.x: BRIC is chaired by the Union S&T Minister; the DBT Secretary is its ex officio Director-General.

n816c5b6e9fe.s:
Assertion (A): CSIR, set up in September 1942, is a statutory corporation.
Reason (R): CSIR is an autonomous body registered as a society.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n816c5b6e9fe.x: CSIR is a registered society, not a statutory corporation, so A is false and R is true.

n5ffec60d28e.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n5ffec60d28e.x: NM-ICPS was launched in 2018 with Rs 3,660 crore; Vigyan Jyoti is a DST scheme and DST is nodal for the RDI Scheme.

nad19ae5c147.s: Under the ANRF Act, 2023, SERB was:
nad19ae5c147.x: The ANRF Act, 2023 repealed the SERB Act, 2008 and subsumed SERB into ANRF; its schemes continue.

n0850c944fc1.s: The Bose Institute, Kolkata (1917), is India's nodal body for:
n0850c944fc1.x: The Bose Institute, a DST autonomous institute founded by J.C. Bose, is India's nodal body for FAIR.

n00728a5a7e0.s: The world's first steel slag road was developed by:
n00728a5a7e0.x: CRRI built the steel slag road; NAL made HANSA-3 (NG) and CMERI the FAIR beam catcher.

ndd0353ccb16.s: Which public sector undertaking is controlled by DSIR?
ndd0353ccb16.x: DSIR controls two PSUs, NRDC and CEL; CSIR is a research organisation, not a PSU.

nf7aabdf7be1.s: BIRAC, DBT's not-for-profit company for biotech start-ups, was set up in:
nf7aabdf7be1.x: BIRAC was set up in 2012, not 2008.

n81cc40e9329.x: SERB-POWER is for women researchers; the SERB Overseas Fellowship is for the diaspora.

n2ada309c7e0.s: CSIR's Central Salt and Marine Chemicals Research Institute (CSMCRI) is located at:
n2ada309c7e0.x: CSMCRI, established in 1954, is at Bhavnagar and works on salt, marine chemicals and desalination.

n6453f13fb15.s: PRISM, PACE, BIRD-crf and A2K+ are components of the Umbrella Industrial R&D scheme of:
n6453f13fb15.x: All four are components of DSIR's Umbrella Industrial R&D scheme.

nbfb9d233ab7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Space Commission?
o: The Department of Space reports to the Minister of Science and Technology
It is associated with the Department of Space
It is chaired by the Secretary, DoS, who is also the ISRO Chairman
nbfb9d233ab7.x: The Department of Space reports directly to the Prime Minister.

n7e3d8fa1a87.s: Which ICMR institute is INCORRECTLY matched with its location?
o: National Institute for Research in Tuberculosis – Pune
n7e3d8fa1a87.x: NIRT is at Chennai, like NIE; Pune has NIV.

nindian-geography-22-25.s: Which of the following institutes is INCORRECTLY matched with its location?
o: Indian Institute of Farming Systems Research – Modipuram
Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture – Jhansi
National Institute of Agricultural Economics & Policy Research – New Delhi
nindian-geography-22-25.x: The Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture is at Lucknow; Jhansi has the Agroforestry institute.

nindian-geography-22-42.s:
Assertion (A): ICRISAT is located in Hyderabad.
Reason (R): The Central Soil Salinity Research Institute is located in Karnal.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nindian-geography-22-42.x: Both locations are correct, but one institute's location does not explain the other's.

n870bb00812b.s:
Assertion (A): ICMR functions under the Department of Health Research.
Reason (R): CSIR functions under the Department of Space.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n870bb00812b.x: ICMR is under DHR, but CSIR is under DSIR; ISRO is under the Department of Space.

nindian-geography-22-49.s: The Indian Bureau of Mines is headquartered at:
nindian-geography-22-49.x: IBM is at Nagpur; CIMFR is at Dhanbad and NATMO at Kolkata.

nd8b670e2a71.s: Which body is India's regulator for nuclear and radiation safety?
nd8b670e2a71.x: AERB regulates nuclear and radiation safety; IREL handles beach-sand minerals and the Heavy Water Board makes heavy water.

nbdda5c55b89.s: The Central Institute of Freshwater Aquaculture (CIFA) is located at:
nbdda5c55b89.x: CIFA is at Bhubaneswar; CRRI/NRRI is at Cuttack and ICRISAT at Patancheru.

nindian-geography-22-27.s: The Central Citrus Research Institute is located at:
nindian-geography-22-27.x: The Central Citrus Research Institute is at Nagpur.

nenvironment-28-2.s: The Indian Institute of Forest Management (IIFM) is located at:
nenvironment-28-2.x: IIFM is at Bhopal; FRI is at Dehradun and the Himalayan Forest Research Institute at Shimla.

n46fb5f64b1e.s: LIGO-India is planned at Aundh in which district of Maharashtra?
n46fb5f64b1e.x: LIGO-India's site is at Aundh, Hingoli district, with DAE, DST and the US NSF.

nindian-geography-22-3.s: The Indian Grassland & Fodder Research Institute is located at:
nindian-geography-22-3.x: IGFRI is at Jhansi; Bhopal has the soil science institute and Karnal the NDRI.

na47b6012551.s: The FAIR accelerator is located at:
na47b6012551.x: FAIR is at Darmstadt, Germany; Cadarache, France is the ITER site.

o: Indian Institute of Oil Palm Research
Indian Institute of Oilseeds and Pulses Research
Indian Institute of Organic Plant Research
Indian Institute of Oil and Petroleum Research
nap-geography-18-10.x: IIOPR is the Indian Institute of Oil Palm Research.

n1bf6d3935b7.s: The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) was established in:
n1bf6d3935b7.x: ICAR was established in 1929; DARE, its administrative department, came in December 1973.

n3033b0c6b24.s: The headquarters of ICFRE is at:
n3033b0c6b24.x: ICFRE (MoEFCC) is headquartered at Dehradun; Hyderabad hosts the Institute of Forest Biodiversity.

nf66f2ee3085.s: The Department of Atomic Energy was set up in 1954 by:
nf66f2ee3085.x: DAE was set up in 1954 by a Presidential Order, not an Act, and is directly under the Prime Minister.

nap-geography-18-5.s: The Indian Institute of Oil Palm Research (IIOPR) is located at:

nindian-geography-22-14.s: The National Plant Protection Training Institute is located in:
nindian-geography-22-14.x: NPPTI is in Hyderabad; the Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine & Storage is at Faridabad.

nindian-geography-22-32.s: The Army's Institute of Military Law is located at:
nindian-geography-22-32.x: The Institute of Military Law is at Kamptee near Nagpur; Pune has the Institute of National Integration.

nap-geography-18-11.s: The Central Tobacco Research Institute (CTRI) is located at:
nap-geography-18-11.x: CTRI is at Rajahmundry; NIO has a regional centre at Visakhapatnam.

n1be411b44a5.s: NewSpace India Limited (NSIL), ISRO's commercial arm, was established in:
n1be411b44a5.x: NSIL was set up in 2019; Antrix dates from 1992 (Miniratna 2008) and IN-SPACe from 2020.

ne8834329435.s: DST and DAE share India's participation in the FAIR accelerator in the ratio:
ne8834329435.x: For FAIR (Darmstadt), Bose Institute is the nodal institution and DST and DAE participate 50:50.

n1dfb2e4f05b.x: ISRO came in 1969; INCOSPAR was formed in 1962 under Vikram Sarabhai and DAE.

nb2ab1b4d339.s: The Central Potato Research Institute is located at:
nb2ab1b4d339.x: CPRI is at Shimla; CAZRI is at Jodhpur and NDRI at Karnal.

nc47b9df17f8.s: The Indian lead institution for ITER is ITER-India at:
nc47b9df17f8.x: ITER (Cadarache, France) has ITER-India at IPR Gandhinagar as the Indian lead institution.

n3d94747ed75.s: LVM3-M6, launched on 24 December 2025, carried which payload, the heaviest ever launched from India?
n3d94747ed75.x: LVM3-M6 placed BlueBird Block-2 in orbit, described as the heaviest payload launched from India.

n363de00268d.s: Which BARC reactor is fuelled by uranium-233?
n363de00268d.x: KAMINI is the only U-233-fuelled reactor of the group; APSARA was Asia's first research reactor and Dhruva the largest.

n31a350ee07a.s: Krishi Vigyan Kendras, 100% centrally funded under ICAR, function under how many ATARIs?
n31a350ee07a.x: KVKs are district-level centres under ICAR, each under one of 11 ATARIs.

n605cbdee629.s: The Institute of Forest Biodiversity is located at:
n605cbdee629.x: The Institute of Forest Biodiversity is at Hyderabad; Jabalpur has the Tropical Forest Research Institute.

n6e836df370c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Indian Science Congress Association (ISCA)?
o: It was founded in 1914 on the initiative of J.L. Simonsen and P.S. MacMahon
Its headquarters is in New Delhi
Its first session was held at the Asiatic Society, Kolkata
Its first session was presided over by Sir Ashutosh Mukherjee
n6e836df370c.x: ISCA's headquarters is in Kolkata, not New Delhi.

neb7324267ae.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about DD Science and India Science?
o: DD Science is a one-hour daily science slot on DD National
India Science is an Internet-based science channel
India Science is run by NCSM
neb7324267ae.x: India Science is run by Vigyan Prasar, not NCSM.

n874e4a6aba6.s:
Assertion (A): The National Council of Science Museums is an autonomous society under the Ministry of Science and Technology.
Reason (R): The National Council of Science Museums was formed on 4 April 1978.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n874e4a6aba6.x: NCSM is under the Ministry of Culture, so A is false; it was formed on 4 April 1978 with headquarters at Kolkata.

n7d4f164f6ae.s: The National Academy of Sciences, India (NASI) is headquartered at:
n7d4f164f6ae.x: NASI is at Prayagraj, IASc at Bengaluru and INSA at New Delhi.

na077b0b559d.s: The National Academy of Sciences, India (NASI) was founded in:
na077b0b559d.x: NASI was founded in 1930, IASc in 1934 and INSA in 1935.

nba1836e4626.s: The India International Science Festival (IISF) began in:
nba1836e4626.x: IISF began in 2015 in New Delhi, organised by MoST and MoES with Vijnana Bharati.

nd10df0b783b.s: Which body scouts, supports and spreads grassroots innovations and outstanding traditional knowledge?
nd10df0b783b.x: This is the mandate of the National Innovation Foundation.

n705f1115a90.s: Science Express, DST's exhibition train, was first flagged off in:
n705f1115a90.x: Science Express, run by DST with the Vikram A. Sarabhai Community Science Centre, was first flagged off in 2007.

n25f91408d3d.s: Which of the following schemes is INCORRECTLY matched with its focus?
o: SEED – Gender equity through structural reforms in institutions
CURIE – Research facilities for 22 Women PG Colleges
WiSLP – Early- and mid-career women scientists with the British Council
GATI – Gender equity through structural reforms in institutions
n25f91408d3d.x: SEED has set up STI Hubs for SC/ST communities; institutional gender equity is GATI's focus.

ne9a9b1ef3c0.s:
Assertion (A): The RDI Scheme, approved on 1 July 2025, provides ₹1 lakh crore over six years.
Reason (R): The RDI Scheme is steered by the Governing Board of ANRF, with DST as the nodal department.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ne9a9b1ef3c0.x: Both describe the RDI Scheme correctly, but its steering arrangement does not explain its funding size.

ne6f5728a312.s:
Assertion (A): INSPIRE-SHE supports students in higher education rather than school students.
Reason (R): SHE is the Scholarship for Higher Education, for top-ranked UG and PG students in natural and basic sciences.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ne6f5728a312.x: SHE is the higher-education scholarship for top UG and PG science students, which is why it targets higher education.

n1cc90190525.s: WISE-KIRAN, which includes WISE-PhD, WISE-PDF and WIDUSHI, is an initiative of:
n1cc90190525.x: WISE-KIRAN is a DST initiative for women scientists, especially those with career breaks.

n48af6087349.s: The Smart India Hackathon is associated with the Innovation Cell of:
n48af6087349.x: SIH is run with the Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell, with AICTE as partner since 2017.

n5c44fcef8c5.s: Which of the following is a DST infrastructure-upgradation programme rather than a brain-gain scheme?
n5c44fcef8c5.x: FIST upgrades infrastructure; VAJRA, Ramanujan Fellowship and INSPIRE aim at brain gain.

n837e2e21cae.s: The National Supercomputing Mission (2015) is implemented by C-DAC and:
n837e2e21cae.x: NSM, run by DST and MeitY, is implemented by C-DAC and IISc Bengaluru, not IIT Bombay.

nf5875e55947.s: Under the Atal Innovation Mission, which component focuses on rural and underserved areas?
nf5875e55947.x: ACICs focus on rural and underserved areas; ATLs are in schools and AICs support start-ups.

ne80ef5ea1ee.s: SEATS (Scheme for Early Attraction of Talents for Science) targets:
ne80ef5ea1ee.x: SEATS targets school students; AORC concerns doctoral and post-doctoral careers.

n0f3037b5626.s: NM-ICPS provides for how many Technology Innovation Hubs set up as Section-8 companies?
n0f3037b5626.x: NM-ICPS provides for 25 Technology Innovation Hubs as Section-8 companies in host institutes.
